versions.changelog:
- Initial release of social-week, enabling users to plan, write, and schedule a full 7-day social media content calendar from a single brief.
- Generates native draft posts tailored for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord, and X (on paid plans), including media prompts as needed.
- Supports scheduling and posting directly via PostWire after user approval, with a checklist of what to measure.
- Works even before PostWire setup, guiding users through a free account setup if necessary.
- Adapts future weekly plans based on past performance insights.
